item.title: Waddle to Denver: How One Trade Could Fuel the Broncos' Super Bowl Pursuit
item.description: The Denver Broncos have a problem — or rather, they had one. After falling agonizingly short of the Super Bowl last season, the question hanging over their entire offseason was simple: are they actually close enough, or did they just get lucky? The acquisition of Jaylen Waddle from the Miami Dolphins answers that question loudly and clearly. Denver’s front office believes this team is a weapon away from a championship run, and they’ve just found that weapon.
